snapshot_date.description: Day key in America/Regina. One snapshot per day, upserted so re-running is idempotent.

platform_readiness.description: Weighted readiness across all counted surfaces, 0 to 100

migration_readiness.description: Weighted readiness across cutover-required capabilities only, 0 to 100

page_completion.description: Percent of counted pages at implemented_unverified or better

verified_pages.description: Percent of counted pages at verified

recommendation.description: Capped at not_ready while any blocking gate fails or any P0 is open

confidence.description: Low whenever a material share of the score rests on inference rather than evidence

section_readiness.description: JSON object of section_key to readiness, for the by-section chart

capability_readiness.description: JSON object of migration group_key to readiness, for the parity chart

evidence_coverage.description: Percent of the score backed by evidence rather than inference. Drives confidence.
